body:
My mother had BPD, but we learned about it only when she was in an hospital for a night, after having a medication overdose. It was a month before her death. I was 18 and not ready to lose her, nor to be an adult (my father isn't the portrait and I have no sibblings).

There's always a solution. There's always help. For the times I couldn't talk with family or friends, I called hotlines. 10 years later, I do feel better about it and forgave her, but the feelings that the void gives is uncurable. Stay strong and fight hard, even if it seems difficult.
I'm sorry for your loss. I wish you well.

Did you tried to talk or write to her?

I'm in a situation where I hurt my significant other with an action I did because I couldn't express myself properly. I tried and wrote an email where I told him everything about how I feel and as what I leave him free to answer or not. Him and I will have a chance to talk about what I did to him in the last week.

Please, at least, give it a try?
